def investigate(context, acquire):
    rows = set()
    seq = 0
    in_tx = False
    saved_rows = set()
    saved_seq = 0
    for action in context['actions']:
        op = action['op']
        if op == 'begin':
            in_tx = True
            saved_rows = rows.copy()
            saved_seq = seq
        elif op == 'commit':
            in_tx = False
            saved_rows = set()
            saved_seq = 0
        elif op == 'rollback':
            rows = saved_rows
            seq = saved_seq
            in_tx = False
            saved_rows = set()
            saved_seq = 0
        elif op == 'put':
            id = action['id']
            rows.add(id)
            if id > seq:
                seq = id
        elif op == 'delete':
            id = action['id']
            rows.discard(id)
    return seq + 1
